_comment: Budgets of proofline's own tests (issue 266, A277). REPORT-ONLY while enforce is false: tests/ci/test-durations-ci.mjs prints OVER BUDGET lines in the job summary and exits as node --test did. Package P3b sets enforce to true with numbers measured from CI. Milliseconds before timeouts_scale (read like timeouts.scale of the control plane: 0.5 to 10, else 1). kinds: the A275 defaults (unit 2000/30000, integration 10000/120000, e2e 60000/600000) are the built-in fallback for a missing number. dirs: the most specific path prefix decides the kind of a test file and may override test_ms and suite_ms. legs: reserved for a per-leg total.
